# HeadingOptions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Options for [`Heading`](heading.md) - the deepest options chain in the library, intersecting [`TextBlockOptions`](text-block-options.md) (which itself intersects the text and element bases).

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
type HeadingOptions = TextBlockOptions & Partial<Pick<Heading, HeadingOwnKey>>
```

### `alignment`

```typescript
alignment?: TextAlignmentInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Paragraph alignment. Accepts `'left' | 'center' | 'right' | 'middle' | 'justify' | 'start' | 'end'`.

### `anchorId`

```typescript
anchorId?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

Optional named-anchor id. When set, this heading doubles as a cross-reference target: it records its page number against `anchorId` in the shared TOC registry so a [`SectionLink`](section-link.md) can jump to it and a [`PageNumberOf`](page-number-of.md) can print its page. Independent of `tocIdentifier` (which drives the on-page [`VisualToc`](visual-toc.md)); a heading may carry either, both, or neither.

### `breakAllowed`

```typescript
breakAllowed?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

Whether this element can be split across page boundaries. When false, the element is treated as atomic and will be moved to a new page rather than split. If it doesn't fit on a fresh page either, it renders anyway. Default is true.

### `captureName`

```typescript
captureName?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

Optional author-supplied name/key surfaced in the layout snapshot. Unset by default; a future capture API can populate it.

### `color`

```typescript
color?: ColorInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Text colour. Accepts a palette token (`'slate-800'`) or hex (`'#ff00aa'`).

### `contentDirection`

```typescript
contentDirection?: ContentDirectionInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Inline progression and paragraph base direction; omitted inherits.

### `decoration`

```typescript
decoration?: TextDecorationInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Decoration. Accepts one token or a list: `['underline', 'overline']`.

### `decorationColor`

```typescript
decorationColor?: ColorInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Decoration line colour. Accepts a palette token or hex.

### `decorationStyle`

```typescript
decorationStyle?: DecorationStyleInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Decoration line style. Accepts `'solid' | 'wavy' | 'dashed' | 'dotted'`.

### `decorationThickness`

```typescript
decorationThickness?: LengthInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Decoration line thickness. Accepts a length: `0.75`, `'0.5pt'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

### `ellipsis`

```typescript
ellipsis?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

Ellipsis appended to the last line when `maxLines` clamps the text. Default `…` (U+2026).

### `firstLineIndent`

```typescript
firstLineIndent?: LengthInput | undefined
```

*optional*

First-line indent. Accepts a length: `18`, `'1cm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

### `fontFamily`

```typescript
fontFamily?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

Font family name (e.g. "Helvetica", "Times", "Arial") for weight/italic resolution. When set, fontName is automatically resolved via FontFamilyResolver using the current fontWeight and italic values.

### `fontFeatures`

```typescript
fontFeatures?: Readonly<Record<string, number>> | undefined
```

*optional*

OpenType feature overrides for embedded text, such as { kern: 0, liga: 0 }.

### `fontName`

```typescript
fontName?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

The TTF/OTF path or PDF standard font name for rendering. Assigning marks the font as explicitly set, so the document-level defaultTextStyle cascade will not override it.

### `fontSize`

```typescript
fontSize?: LengthInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Font size. Accepts a length: `12`, `'12pt'`, `'4mm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

### `fontWeight`

```typescript
fontWeight?: FontWeightInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Font weight. Accepts `'bold'`, `'semi-bold'`, … or the numeric value.

### `italic`

```typescript
italic?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

Whether the text should be rendered in italic/oblique style. When fontFamily is set, triggers automatic resolution. When fontFamily is not set, uses the current fontName as the base family for resolution.

### `keepWithNext`

```typescript
keepWithNext?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

Keeps this element with the start of its next sibling in vertical flow.

### `letterSpacing`

```typescript
letterSpacing?: LengthInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Letter spacing (tracking). Accepts a length: `0.4`, `'0.2mm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

### `level`

```typescript
level?: number | undefined
```

*optional*

Heading level (1–6). Maps to PDF/UA structure roles `H1`…`H6` when the document opts into tagging via `DocumentSettings.accessibility`. Default `1`. Values outside 1–6 are clamped.

### `lineHeight`

```typescript
lineHeight?: number | undefined
```

*optional*

Line-height multiplier applied to font size. Defaults to 1.2 if not set. Setting this marks the property as explicitly set, preventing cascade override.

### `margin`

```typescript
margin?: ThicknessInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Margin around this element. Accepts `12`, `[h, v]`, `[l, t, r, b]` or `{ bottom: 12 }`; omitted sides are zero.

### `maxLines`

```typescript
maxLines?: number | undefined
```

*optional*

Line clamp: maximum number of lines to render. When set and the text wraps to more lines, the block is truncated to this many lines and `ellipsis` is appended to the last visible line. Null = no clamp.

### `minLinesAfterBreak`

```typescript
minLinesAfterBreak?: number | undefined
```

*optional*

Minimum number of lines that must appear after a page break (widow control). If fewer lines remain for the next page, the break point is adjusted to push more lines forward. Set to 1 to disable widow control. Default is 2.

### `minLinesBeforeBreak`

```typescript
minLinesBeforeBreak?: number | undefined
```

*optional*

Minimum number of lines to render before a page break (orphan control). If fewer lines fit on the current page, the entire block moves to the next page. Set to 1 to disable orphan control. Default is 2.

### `paragraphSpacing`

```typescript
paragraphSpacing?: LengthInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Gap after each paragraph. Accepts a length: `8`, `'3mm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

### `preserveWhitespace`

```typescript
preserveWhitespace?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

Keep every space, including leading and repeated ones, for text whose indentation carries meaning (source code, a fixed-width listing). Default `false`, which drops a segment's leading spaces.

Lines wrap by code point at the last space that fits, or mid-token when there is none, so a long line never overflows. Tabs are not expanded. Inherited by [`Heading`](heading.md); list items and [`RichText`](rich-text.md) do not take it. Spec 03 "Preserved whitespace".

### `text`

```typescript
text?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

The text to render. A hard `\n` starts a new paragraph.

### `tocIdentifier`

```typescript
tocIdentifier?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

Gets or sets the unique identifier used to look up this heading in the TOC entries dictionary. Must match the identifier passed to VisualToc.HeadingIdentifiers.

### `wordSpacing`

```typescript
wordSpacing?: LengthInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Word spacing. Accepts a length: `1`, `'0.5mm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.
